title: Chungi
description: The rubber-band footbag street game of Nepal. Tap toward where the ball should go, ricochet it off the alley walls, drop it through hoops and chain tricks. Street Run, Hoop Rally, Daily Alley and Watch & Learn modes.
howToPlay: Tap toward the side you want the ball to travel when it is low.
Low contact is a toe poke, middle the inside foot, high a knee pop.
Strike right above the foot for a Perfect kick.
Ricochet off the walls and drop the ball through hoops for bonuses.
The run ends when the ball touches the ground.
